name: Note graphs
description: Logseq graphs and Obsidian vaults opened as themselves: pages, journals, backlinks, block references, tags, tasks and queries, edited as an outliner, on Doom's SPC n r keys; nothing converted, logseq/ and .obsidian/ never written

menus.title: Graph
menus.when: textType == markdown || textType == org || textType == graph-backlinks || textType == graph-pages || textType == graph-journals || textType == graph-tags || textType == graph-tasks || textType == graph-graph || textType == graph-query

graphs.description: Folders that are graphs without Logseq's logseq/config.edn or Obsidian's .obsidian/: a path, or {"path": PATH, "kind": "logseq" or "obsidian"}

obsidian.daily_notes.description: The daily notes' folder of a vault whose .obsidian/daily-notes.json does not say; empty for the vault's root

obsidian.daily_format.description: The daily notes' names, in Moment's tokens, when .obsidian/daily-notes.json does not say

obsidian.new_notes.description: The folder of new notes when .obsidian/app.json does not say; empty for the vault's root

obsidian.link_style.description: How links are written when .obsidian/app.json does not say: the shortest path, relative, from the root, or as Markdown links

glyphs.description: Fold marks and bullets as ▾ and •, or as v and * for a terminal font without them

journals_shown.description: How many journals the Journals document shows
